Fossilization is an unlikely event, and yet it, it happens just enough that we can get a glimpse at the distant past. But sometimes the stars align and an animal gets preserved in such specific and perfect conditions that we get more than a glimpse, we get the full view. These are the dinos we know exactly what they looked like.
